description: This is a shell script file containing functions related to firmware upgrade procedures for Fortinet devices, including byte swapping, partition mapping, firmware info updating, and the upgrade process itself.

methods.name: fortinet_bswap32
methods.description: Swaps the byte order of a 32-bit value for endianness conversion.

methods.name: fortinet_by2bl
methods.description: Converts a byte length to block units, considering block size 0x200.

methods.name: fortinet_bl2by
methods.description: Converts a block count to byte length with block size 0x200.

methods.name: fortinet_build_partmap
methods.description: Builds a partition mapping string based on input parameters, supporting various formats for lengths and offsets.

methods.name: fortinet_update_fwinfo
methods.description: Updates firmware information in the designated firmware-info partition, including the image name and kernel/rootfs offsets and lengths.

methods.name: fortinet_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process by extracting kernel and rootfs images from a given archive and updating their respective MTD partitions.
